h.en: 2.1(a) Dehydration and desalting of crude oil — construction and working of an electrostatic desalter
h.gu: 2.1(a) Crude oil નું dehydration તથા desalting — electrostatic desalter નું construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

Crude leaving the oilfield contains emulsified formation water holding dissolved salts (mainly chlorides of sodium, calcium and magnesium). Dehydration removes the water; desalting removes the salt dissolved in that water and in the crude, before the crude is heated.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Inlet and distributor: crude, mixed with 3–10 % fresh wash water and demulsifier, enters and is spread across the vessel.
  2. Electrode grids: high-voltage AC/DC electrodes create an electric field in the oil.
  3. Oil–water interface: coalesced water settles below; desalted oil leaves from the top.
  4. Water outlet and mud wash: salty water (brine) is drawn off; settled solids are flushed periodically.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Wash water dissolves/dilutes the salts; demulsifier weakens the emulsion film around water droplets.
  2. The electric field polarises droplets so they attract, coalesce into large drops and settle by gravity — oil and water do not mix, so size is what makes settling fast.
  3. Desalted crude (typically a few mg salt per litre, as specified) goes to preheat; the worked salt balance is Numerical 2.N3.

Limitations and safety

Salt left in crude hydrolyses in the hot unit to hydrochloric acid and corrodes the overhead system, and deposits foul preheat exchangers. Desalting removes salt carried in water; it cannot remove oil-soluble organic chlorides, which need separate attention. High-voltage equipment is operated only under refinery procedures.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Oilfield માંથી આવતા crude માં emulsified formation water હોય છે જેમાં dissolved salts (મુખ્યત્વે sodium, calcium તથા magnesium ના chlorides) હોય છે. Dehydration water દૂર કરે છે; desalting crude ગરમ થાય તે પહેલાં તે water તથા crude માંનું salt દૂર કરે છે.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Inlet તથા distributor: crude, 3–10 % fresh wash water તથા demulsifier સાથે ભળીને vessel માં ફેલાય છે.
  2. Electrode grids: high-voltage AC/DC electrodes oil માં electric field બનાવે છે.
  3. Oil–water interface: coalesce થયેલું water નીચે બેસે છે; desalted oil ઉપરથી નીકળે છે.
  4. Water outlet તથા mud wash: salty water (brine) બહાર ખેંચાય છે; બેઠેલા solids સમયાંતરે flush થાય છે.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Wash water salts ને ઓગાળે/ dilute કરે છે; demulsifier water droplets આસપાસની emulsion film નબળી કરે છે.
  2. Electric field droplets ને polarise કરે છે જેથી તેઓ આકર્ષાય, coalesce થઈ મોટા drops બને અને gravity થી બેસી જાય — oil તથા water ભળતા નથી, તેથી drop size જ settling ઝડપી કરે છે.
  3. Desalted crude (સામાન્ય રીતે specification મુજબ થોડા mg salt per litre) preheat તરફ જાય છે; worked salt balance Numerical 2.N3 માં છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Crude માં રહેલું salt hot unit માં hydrochloric acid બનાવી overhead system ને corrode કરે છે, અને deposits preheat exchangers foul કરે છે. Desalting water માંનું salt દૂર કરે છે; oil-soluble organic chlorides દૂર કરી શકતું નથી, તેમને અલગ ધ્યાન જોઈએ છે. High-voltage equipment ફક્ત refinery procedures હેઠળ જ ચલાવાય છે.

h.en: 2.1(b) Pipe still heaters — construction and working of the crude furnace
h.gu: 2.1(b) Pipe still heaters — crude furnace નું construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

A pipe still (tube still) heater is the fired furnace that heats desalted crude, flowing inside tubes, to the temperature needed for flashing into the atmospheric column — roughly 330–370 °C at the heater outlet for a typical crude, set by the crude assay.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Radiant section: tubes around the firebox receive heat mainly by radiation from the flame; the highest heat flux is here.
  2. Convection section: tubes above the firebox recover heat from hot flue gases leaving the radiant zone.
  3. Burners and fuel system: burn refinery gas/fuel oil with controlled excess air.
  4. Stack: discharges flue gas; its temperature shows how much heat was recovered.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Cold crude enters the convection tubes first, recovering waste heat, then passes to the radiant tubes — coldest fluid meets coolest gas, hottest fluid meets the flame zone.
  2. Inside the tubes the crude stays largely liquid under pressure; it flashes only when it enters the column at lower pressure.
  3. The heating duty follows Q = m·cp·ΔT (Numerical 2.N1, with heater efficiency converting duty into fuel firing).

Limitations and safety

Too high a tube-skin temperature cracks crude inside the tubes and lays down coke, which insulates the tube, overheats the metal and can rupture it. Heaters therefore control outlet temperature, flow per tube pass and flame pattern, and are operated strictly under refinery firing procedures; the calculations here size duty, they are not firing instructions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Pipe still (tube still) heater એ fired furnace છે જે desalted crude ને, tubes ની અંદર વહેતું, atmospheric column માં flashing માટે જરૂરી temperature સુધી ગરમ કરે છે — typical crude માટે heater outlet પર આશરે 330–370 °C, જે crude assay થી નક્કી થાય છે.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Radiant section: firebox આસપાસની tubes મુખ્યત્વે flame ના radiation થી heat મેળવે છે; સૌથી વધુ heat flux અહીં છે.
  2. Convection section: firebox ઉપરની tubes radiant zone માંથી નીકળતા hot flue gases માંથી heat recover કરે છે.
  3. Burners તથા fuel system: refinery gas/fuel oil ને controlled excess air સાથે બાળે છે.
  4. Stack: flue gas બહાર કાઢે છે; તેનું temperature કેટલી heat recover થઈ તે બતાવે છે.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Cold crude પહેલાં convection tubes માં પ્રવેશી waste heat recover કરે છે, પછી radiant tubes તરફ જાય છે — ઠંડામાં ઠંડુ fluid સૌથી ઠંડા gas ને, ગરમ fluid flame zone ને મળે છે.
  2. Tubes ની અંદર crude દબાણ હેઠળ મોટેભાગે liquid રહે છે; તે column માં ઓછા દબાણે પ્રવેશે ત્યારે જ flash થાય છે.
  3. Heating duty Q = m·cp·ΔT મુજબ છે (Numerical 2.N1, જેમાં heater efficiency duty ને fuel firing માં ફેરવે છે).

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

વધુ પડતું tube-skin temperature tubes ની અંદર crude ને crack કરી coke જમા કરે છે, જે tube ને insulate કરે છે, metal ને overheat કરે છે અને rupture કરી શકે છે. તેથી heaters outlet temperature, દરેક tube pass દીઠ flow તથા flame pattern નિયંત્રિત કરે છે અને કડક refinery firing procedures હેઠળ ચાલે છે; અહીંની ગણતરીઓ duty નો અંદાજ આપે છે, firing instructions નથી.

h.en: 2.2 Atmospheric distillation unit (ADU) — construction and working of the crude column
h.gu: 2.2 Atmospheric distillation unit (ADU) — crude column નું construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

The atmospheric distillation unit separates heated crude at about atmospheric pressure into fractions by boiling range, in one continuous fractionating column. It is the first and largest separation in every refinery.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Flash zone: hot crude from the pipe still enters near the bottom; vapour rises, unflashed liquid falls as atmospheric residue.
  2. Trays (or packing) and downcomers: rising vapour contacts descending liquid (reflux) on each tray, so lighter components concentrate upward.
  3. Side draws with side strippers: kerosene and diesel fractions are withdrawn at tray heights matching their boiling ranges and steam-stripped of light ends.
  4. Overhead system: top vapour is condensed to LPG and light naphtha, with reflux returned to control top temperature.
  5. Bottoms: atmospheric residue is sent to the vacuum unit (topic 2.3) or fuel blending.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Temperature falls from bottom to top of the column; each tray is a partial condensation/evaporation stage.
  2. A component leaves where the tray temperature matches its boiling range — hence the product order of Unit 1.6 down the column side.
  3. Reflux and pumparounds (liquid withdrawn, cooled and returned) remove heat and sharpen the separation between adjacent products.

Limitations and safety

One column gives specification products only within limits: adjacent cuts overlap, and the heaviest part cannot be boiled at atmospheric pressure without cracking — that is exactly why the residue goes to vacuum distillation instead of being heated harder.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Atmospheric distillation unit ગરમ crude ને આશરે atmospheric pressure પર એક continuous fractionating column માં boiling range મુજબ fractions માં છૂટું પાડે છે. તે દરેક refinery નું પ્રથમ અને સૌથી મોટું separation છે.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Flash zone: pipe still માંથી hot crude તળિયાની નજીક પ્રવેશે છે; vapour ઉપર જાય છે, unflashed liquid atmospheric residue તરીકે નીચે પડે છે.
  2. Trays (કે packing) તથા downcomers: ચઢતી vapour દરેક tray પર ઊતરતા liquid (reflux) ના સંપર્કમાં આવે છે, જેથી હલકા components ઉપર concentrate થાય છે.
  3. Side draws તથા side strippers: kerosene તથા diesel fractions તેમના boiling ranges ને મળતી tray heights પરથી ખેંચાય છે અને light ends steam-strip થાય છે.
  4. Overhead system: top vapour condense થઈ LPG તથા light naphtha બને છે, reflux પાછું આપી top temperature નિયંત્રિત થાય છે.
  5. Bottoms: atmospheric residue vacuum unit (topic 2.3) કે fuel blending તરફ જાય છે.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Column માં temperature તળિયેથી ટોચે ઘટે છે; દરેક tray partial condensation/evaporation stage છે.
  2. Component ત્યાં નીકળે છે જ્યાં tray temperature તેના boiling range ને મળે છે — તેથી જ Unit 1.6 નો product order column ની બાજુમાં જોવા મળે છે.
  3. Reflux તથા pumparounds (liquid ખેંચી, ઠંડું કરી પાછું આપવું) heat દૂર કરે છે અને adjacent products વચ્ચેનું separation sharp કરે છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

એક column મર્યાદામાં જ specification products આપે છે: adjacent cuts overlap થાય છે, અને સૌથી ભારે ભાગ atmospheric pressure પર cracking વગર ઊકાળી શકાતો નથી — બરાબર તેથી જ residue વધુ ગરમ કરવાને બદલે vacuum distillation તરફ જાય છે.

h.en: Derivation: overall and component balances of a distillation column
h.gu: Derivation: distillation column ના overall તથા component balances

body.en:
Symbols, model and assumptions

Steady continuous column; feed F, total overhead/distillate product D and bottoms B (mass or molar flows, used consistently). x denotes the mass (or mole) fraction of one chosen light component in each stream: xF, xD, xB. No reaction and no accumulation at steady state.

  1. Write the overall balance: what enters must leave.

    F = D + B

  2. Write the light-component balance in the same way.

    F·xF = D·xD + B·xB

  3. Replace B by (F − D) from step 1.

    F·xF = D·xD + (F − D)·xB

  4. Collect the D terms and divide.

    D·(xD − xB) = F·(xF − xB)

  5. State the product split.

    D = F·(xF − xB) / (xD − xB), B = F − D

4-mark / 7-mark study depth

4-mark path: F = D + B → component balance → substitute B → boxed split. For a full 7-mark format reproduce every step and state steady state, no reaction and the consistent flow basis. These are study formats, not guaranteed official question marks. Numerical 2.N2 uses this result.
body.gu:
સંકેતો, Model તથા Assumptions

Steady continuous column; feed F, કુલ overhead/distillate product D અને bottoms B (mass કે molar flows, સતત એક જ basis). x પસંદ કરેલા એક light component નો દરેક stream માં mass (કે mole) fraction દર્શાવે છે: xF, xD, xB. Steady state પર reaction નહીં અને accumulation નહીં.

  1. Overall balance લખો: જે પ્રવેશે તે જ બહાર નીકળવું જોઈએ.

    F = D + B

  2. Light-component balance એ જ રીતે લખો.

    F·xF = D·xD + B·xB

  3. Step 1 પરથી B ને (F − D) થી બદલો.

    F·xF = D·xD + (F − D)·xB

  4. D વાળા terms એકત્ર કરી ભાગાકાર કરો.

    D·(xD − xB) = F·(xF − xB)

  5. Product split જણાવો.

    D = F·(xF − xB) / (xD − xB), B = F − D

4-mark / 7-mark Study Depth

4-mark માટેનો path: F = D + B → component balance → B substitute કરો → boxed split. Full 7-mark format માટે દરેક step તથા steady state, no reaction અને consistent flow basis જણાવો. આ study formats છે; official marks ની ખાતરી નથી. Numerical 2.N2 આ result વાપરે છે.

h.en: 2.3 Vacuum distillation unit (VDU) — why vacuum, and how the column works
h.gu: 2.3 Vacuum distillation unit (VDU) — vacuum કેમ, અને column કેવી રીતે કામ કરે છે

body.en:
Definition / principle

The vacuum distillation unit distils atmospheric residue under reduced pressure so that heavy fractions boil at much lower temperatures and are recovered without thermal cracking.

Detailed theory and conditions

A liquid boils when its vapour pressure equals the surrounding pressure. Lowering the column pressure to a small fraction of an atmosphere (vacuum made by steam ejectors and condensers, of the order of a few kPa at the top) therefore lowers every boiling point in the residue. Atmospheric residue is reheated in a vacuum heater only as much as needed, flashed into the large-diameter vacuum column (wide because vapour volume is huge at low pressure), and separated into vacuum gas oil (feed for FCC/hydrocracking, Unit III) and, where operated, lube distillate cuts, leaving vacuum residue (short residue) for bitumen, fuel oil or coking.

Key points and data

  • Vacuum system: steam-jet ejectors with barometric/surface condensers remove air and cracked gas and hold the vacuum.
  • Steam injection at the heater/column lowers hydrocarbon partial pressure further, like a partial vacuum of its own.
  • Products: light and heavy vacuum gas oil, lube cuts (in a lube refinery), vacuum residue.

Qualification

Vacuum does not create new separation power for free: air leakage, ejector steam and the very large column all cost money, and the residue still cannot be distilled to dryness — the last part always leaves as residue for bitumen, fuel or conversion.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Vacuum distillation unit atmospheric residue ને reduced pressure હેઠળ distill કરે છે જેથી ભારે fractions ઘણા ઓછા temperatures પર ઊકળે અને thermal cracking વગર recover થાય.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Liquid ત્યારે ઊકળે છે જ્યારે તેનું vapour pressure આસપાસના pressure બરાબર થાય. Column pressure ને atmosphere ના નાના ભાગ સુધી ઘટાડવાથી (steam ejectors તથા condensers થી બનતું vacuum, top પર થોડા kPa ક્રમનું) residue ના દરેક boiling points નીચે આવે છે. Atmospheric residue vacuum heater માં જરૂર પૂરતું જ ફરી ગરમ થાય છે, મોટા-diameter વાળા vacuum column માં flash થાય છે (low pressure પર vapour volume વિશાળ હોવાથી column પહોળું), અને vacuum gas oil (FCC/hydrocracking નો feed, Unit III) તથા, જ્યાં ચાલે ત્યાં, lube distillate cuts માં છૂટું પડે છે, જેથી vacuum residue (short residue) bitumen, fuel oil કે coking માટે રહે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Vacuum system: barometric/surface condensers સાથે steam-jet ejectors air તથા cracked gas દૂર કરી vacuum જાળવે છે.
  • Steam injection heater/column પર hydrocarbon partial pressure વધુ ઘટાડે છે, જાણે પોતાનું આંશિક vacuum.
  • Products: light તથા heavy vacuum gas oil, lube cuts (lube refinery માં), vacuum residue.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Vacuum મફતમાં નવી separation power બનાવતું નથી: air leakage, ejector steam તથા ખૂબ મોટું column બધાં ખર્ચાળ છે, અને residue હજુ પણ સુકાઈ જાય ત્યાં સુધી distill થઈ શકતું નથી — છેલ્લો ભાગ હંમેશા bitumen, fuel કે conversion માટે residue તરીકે જ નીકળે છે.

title.en: 2.4 Physical properties of petroleum products and their measurement
title.gu: 2.4 Petroleum products ના physical properties તથા તેમનું measurement

h.en: 2.4(a) Petrol — properties that define a motor gasoline and how each is measured
h.gu: 2.4(a) Petrol — motor gasoline ને વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરતા properties તથા દરેકનું measurement

body.en:
Definition / principle

A petrol (gasoline) is specified by how it evaporates, knocks and flows — not by composition alone. The defining properties are octane number, vapour pressure, distillation range, density, sulfur and gum/olefin-aromatic content within specification limits.

Key points and data

PropertyWhat it controlsHow it is measured
Octane number (RON/MON)Resistance to knocking in a petrol engineStandard CFR engine against iso-octane (100) / n-heptane (0) reference fuels; research and motor methods differ in severity
Reid vapour pressure (RVP)Easy starting vs vapour lock and evaporative lossVapour pressure of the sample at 37.8 °C in a standard bomb
Distillation (IBP, % evaporated, FBP)Starting, warm-up, acceleration and depositsStandard batch distillation recording temperature vs volume recovered
Density / APIMetering, energy per litre, blend controlHydrometer or digital density meter at reference temperature

Qualification

Octane blending is only approximately linear by volume (Numerical 2.N4 states that assumption); real blends interact, and ethanol or other oxygenates change both octane and vapour pressure, so finished petrol is always tested, never only calculated.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Petrol (gasoline) તે કેવી રીતે evaporate થાય છે, knock કરે છે અને વહે છે તેનાથી specified થાય છે — ફક્ત composition થી નહીં. વ્યાખ્યાયિત properties છે octane number, vapour pressure, distillation range, density, sulfur તથા gum/olefin-aromatic content — specification limits ની અંદર.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

Propertyતે શું નિયંત્રિત કરે છેકેવી રીતે મપાય છે

Reid vapour pressure (RVP)સરળ starting vs vapour lock તથા evaporative lossStandard bomb માં 37.8 °C પર sample નું vapour pressure

h.en: 2.4(b) Diesel — cetane, flash point, cloud and pour points, viscosity
h.gu: 2.4(b) Diesel — cetane, flash point, cloud તથા pour points, viscosity

body.en:
Definition / principle

A diesel fuel is specified for a compression-ignition engine: it must ignite promptly, flow and atomise when cold, and burn without excessive smoke or deposits.

Key points and data

  • Cetane number: ignition quality — the shorter the ignition delay, the higher the cetane number; measured in a standard diesel engine (or by calculated cetane index from density and distillation, for routine control).
  • Flash point: the lowest temperature at which vapour above the liquid flashes with a test flame; a safety and contamination check, measured for diesel in a closed-cup (Pensky-Martens) tester (Practical 3 pattern).
  • Cloud point: temperature at which wax crystals first make the oil cloudy on cooling; pour point: temperature below which it no longer flows when the test jar is tilted (Practicals 11–12 pattern). Cloud is always at or above pour.
  • Viscosity: controls pumpability and spray atomisation; measured by capillary (kinematic) or efflux (Redwood/Saybolt) viscometers (Practical 14 pattern).

Qualification

A diesel can pass every test in summer and still fail in the field in winter if its cloud/pour behaviour is wrong for the climate; specifications therefore change with season and region.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Diesel fuel compression-ignition engine માટે specified છે: તે તરત ignite થવું જોઈએ, ઠંડામાં flow તથા atomise થવું જોઈએ, અને વધુ પડતા smoke કે deposits વગર બળવું જોઈએ.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Cetane number: ignition quality — ignition delay જેટલો ટૂંકો, cetane number તેટલો વધુ; standard diesel engine માં મપાય છે (કે routine control માટે density તથા distillation પરથી calculated cetane index).
  • Flash point: સૌથી નીચું temperature કે જ્યાં liquid ઉપરની vapour test flame થી flash થાય; safety તથા contamination check, diesel માટે closed-cup (Pensky-Martens) tester માં મપાય છે (Practical 3 pattern).
  • Cloud point: temperature કે જ્યાં ઠંડું પડતાં wax crystals પહેલાં oil ને cloudy કરે; pour point: temperature કે જેનાથી નીચે test jar નમાવતાં oil વહેતું નથી (Practicals 11–12 pattern). Cloud હંમેશા pour પર કે ઉપર હોય છે.
  • Viscosity: pumpability તથા spray atomisation નિયંત્રિત કરે છે; capillary (kinematic) કે efflux (Redwood/Saybolt) viscometers થી મપાય છે (Practical 14 pattern).

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Diesel ઉનાળામાં દરેક test pass કરી શકે છે અને છતાં શિયાળામાં field માં fail થઈ શકે છે જો તેનું cloud/pour વર્તન climate માટે ખોટું હોય; તેથી specifications season તથા region મુજબ બદલાય છે.

h.en: 2.4(c) Kerosene — smoke point, flash point, freezing point and char value
h.gu: 2.4(c) Kerosene — smoke point, flash point, freezing point તથા char value

body.en:
Definition / principle

Kerosene, and its refined form aviation turbine fuel (ATF/Jet fuel), must burn with a clean, non-smoky flame and stay liquid at the low temperatures of high-altitude flight.

Key points and data

  • Smoke point: the height (mm) of flame that can be raised in a standard lamp without smoking; higher smoke point means cleaner burning (more paraffinic, less aromatic) — Practical 10 pattern.
  • Flash point: closed-cup safety test as for diesel; kerosene specifications set a minimum for safe handling and storage.
  • Freezing point: temperature at which wax crystals appear on cooling (critical for jet fuel at altitude, where fuel gets very cold).
  • Char value: mass of carbon residue left on the wick of a standard lamp after burning a fixed quantity; a cleanliness check for lamp kerosene.

Qualification

Smoke point and freezing point pull composition in opposite directions to octane-type thinking: the aromatics that help petrol hurt kerosene burning quality, which is why kerosene is often hydrotreated or solvent-extracted (Unit IV, liquid SO2 extraction).
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Kerosene, અને તેનું refined સ્વરૂપ aviation turbine fuel (ATF/Jet fuel), સ્વચ્છ, non-smoky flame થી બળવું જોઈએ અને high-altitude flight ના નીચા temperatures પર liquid રહેવું જોઈએ.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Smoke point: standard lamp માં smoking વગર ઊંચી કરી શકાય તેટલી flame ની ઊંચાઈ (mm); વધુ smoke point એટલે સ્વચ્છ burning (વધુ paraffinic, ઓછું aromatic) — Practical 10 pattern.
  • Flash point: diesel મુજબ closed-cup safety test; kerosene specifications safe handling તથા storage માટે minimum નક્કી કરે છે.
  • Freezing point: temperature કે જ્યાં ઠંડું પડતાં wax crystals દેખાય (altitude પર jet fuel માટે critical, જ્યાં fuel ખૂબ ઠંડું પડે છે).
  • Char value: નિશ્ચિત જથ્થો બાળ્યા પછી standard lamp ની wick પર રહેતા carbon residue નો mass; lamp kerosene માટે cleanliness check.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Smoke point તથા freezing point composition ને octane-type વિચારની વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં ખેંચે છે: petrol ને મદદ કરતા aromatics kerosene ની burning quality બગાડે છે, તેથી જ kerosene ઘણીવાર hydrotreat કે solvent-extract થાય છે (Unit IV, liquid SO2 extraction).

h.en: 2.4(d) Lubricant oil — viscosity, viscosity index, flash and pour points
h.gu: 2.4(d) Lubricant oil — viscosity, viscosity index, flash તથા pour points

body.en:
Definition / principle

A lubricant is specified by the oil film it maintains between moving surfaces over the whole temperature range: thick enough when hot, still flowing when cold, and stable against oxidation.

Key points and data

  • Viscosity (kinematic, mm²/s): measured in a capillary viscometer at stated temperatures (commonly 40 °C and 100 °C); the primary grade number of an oil.
  • Viscosity index (VI): a calculated scale number showing how little the viscosity changes with temperature; high VI (paraffinic, solvent-refined and dewaxed oils) is wanted for engines.
  • Flash and fire points: open/closed-cup heating tests; fire point is the temperature for continuous burning after flashing (Practicals 3–4 pattern) — both are safety and volatile-contamination checks.
  • Pour point and neutralisation/carbon-residue tests: cold-flow limit after dewaxing, acidity, and the coke-forming tendency (Ramsbottom/Conradson, Practicals 8–9 pattern) for engine cleanliness.

Qualification

No single test makes a lubricant: VI is improved by solvent extraction and dewaxing (Unit IV), while finished engine oils also depend on additive packages that base-oil tests alone cannot judge.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Lubricant સમગ્ર temperature range માં moving surfaces વચ્ચે જાળવાતી oil film થી specified છે: ગરમ હોય ત્યારે પૂરતું જાડું, ઠંડું હોય ત્યારે હજુ વહેતું, અને oxidation સામે સ્થિર.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Viscosity (kinematic, mm²/s): જણાવેલા temperatures (સામાન્ય રીતે 40 °C તથા 100 °C) પર capillary viscometer માં મપાય છે; oil નો primary grade number.
  • Viscosity index (VI): viscosity temperature સાથે કેટલું ઓછું બદલાય છે તે બતાવતો calculated scale number; engines માટે high VI (paraffinic, solvent-refined તથા dewaxed oils) ઇચ્છનીય છે.
  • Flash તથા fire points: open/closed-cup heating tests; fire point એ flashing પછી સતત બળવા માટેનું temperature છે (Practicals 3–4 pattern) — બંને safety તથા volatile-contamination checks છે.
  • Pour point તથા neutralisation/carbon-residue tests: dewaxing પછી cold-flow limit, acidity, અને engine cleanliness માટે coke-forming tendency (Ramsbottom/Conradson, Practicals 8–9 pattern).

મર્યાદા / Qualification

એક પણ test lubricant બનાવતું નથી: VI solvent extraction તથા dewaxing (Unit IV) થી સુધરે છે, જ્યારે finished engine oils additive packages પર પણ આધાર રાખે છે જેને base-oil tests એકલા જજ કરી શકતા નથી.

h.en: 2.4(e) CNG and LPG — gaseous fuels: composition, vapour pressure, calorific value and safety properties
h.gu: 2.4(e) CNG તથા LPG — gaseous fuels: composition, vapour pressure, calorific value તથા safety properties

body.en:
Definition / principle

LPG is liquefied propane/butane stored as liquid under its own vapour pressure; CNG is compressed natural gas (mainly methane) stored as gas at high pressure. Their specifications protect storage, vaporisation and clean burning.

Key points and data

  • Composition / vapour pressure (LPG): propane vaporises easily in cold weather, butane gives more energy per litre; the blend, checked by vapour-pressure and volatility (95 % evaporation) tests, is adjusted to climate.
  • Calorific value and Wobbe index (gas interchangeability): heat released per unit volume and the index that decides whether one gas can replace another in the same burner without adjustment.
  • Density relative to air: LPG vapour is heavier than air and collects at ground level; methane is lighter and rises — this decides ventilation and detector placement.
  • Odorisation: both fuels are dosed with a strong-smelling odorant (mercaptan type) so leaks can be smelled, verified as a specification item.

Qualification

CNG and LPG are not interchangeable in storage or engines despite both being clean gaseous fuels: one is a high-pressure light gas, the other a liquefied heavier gas, and confusing their handling rules is a serious safety error.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

LPG એ પોતાના vapour pressure હેઠળ liquid તરીકે stored liquefied propane/butane છે; CNG એ high pressure પર gas તરીકે stored compressed natural gas (મુખ્યત્વે methane) છે. તેમના specifications storage, vaporisation તથા clean burning નું રક્ષણ કરે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Composition / vapour pressure (LPG): propane ઠંડા હવામાનમાં સહેલાઈથી vaporise થાય છે, butane litre દીઠ વધુ energy આપે છે; vapour-pressure તથા volatility (95 % evaporation) tests થી check થતું blend climate મુજબ ગોઠવાય છે.
  • Calorific value તથા Wobbe index (gas interchangeability): unit volume દીઠ મળતી heat અને એક gas બીજાને adjustment વગર એ જ burner માં બદલી શકે કે કેમ તે નક્કી કરતો index.
  • Density relative to air: LPG vapour air કરતાં ભારે છે અને જમીન સ્તરે એકત્ર થાય છે; methane હલકું છે અને ઉપર જાય છે — તે ventilation તથા detector placement નક્કી કરે છે.
  • Odorisation: બંને fuels માં તીવ્ર ગંધવાળું odorant (mercaptan type) ઉમેરાય છે જેથી leaks સુંઘી શકાય, specification item તરીકે verified.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

બંને clean gaseous fuels હોવા છતાં CNG તથા LPG storage કે engines માં પરસ્પર બદલી શકાય તેવા નથી: એક high-pressure હલકો gas છે, બીજો liquefied ભારે gas છે, અને તેમના handling rules ગૂંચવવા એ ગંભીર safety ભૂલ છે.

h.en: 2.4(f) Grease — penetration, dropping point and structure
h.gu: 2.4(f) Grease — penetration, dropping point તથા structure

body.en:
Definition / principle

A grease is lubricating oil held in a sponge-like soap thickener (commonly lithium, calcium or sodium soap) so that it stays in place where a liquid oil would run away.

Key points and data

  • Penetration (consistency): depth (in tenths of a millimetre) a standard cone sinks into worked grease in a penetrometer (Practical 7 pattern); it sets the NLGI grade from soft (000) to hard (6) — a higher penetration means a softer grease.
  • Dropping point: temperature at which the first drop falls from a standard cup on heating; an upper-temperature guide for the thickener, not a safe continuous-service temperature by itself.
  • Structure and stability: worked vs unworked penetration difference, oil separation and water resistance decide whether the grease keeps its body in a bearing.

Qualification

Penetration alone does not select a grease: a bearing grease must also match temperature (dropping point), water exposure and speed/load, or the correct-consistency grease will still fail in service.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Grease એ sponge જેવા soap thickener (સામાન્ય રીતે lithium, calcium કે sodium soap) માં રખાયેલું lubricating oil છે, જેથી જ્યાં liquid oil વહી જાય ત્યાં તે સ્થાને રહે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Penetration (consistency): worked grease માં standard cone penetrometer માં કેટલી ઊંડાઈ (millimetre ના દસમા ભાગમાં) ડૂબે છે (Practical 7 pattern); તે soft (000) થી hard (6) સુધીનો NLGI grade નક્કી કરે છે — વધુ penetration એટલે નરમ grease.
  • Dropping point: temperature કે જ્યાં ગરમ કરતાં standard cup માંથી પહેલો drop પડે; thickener માટે upper-temperature guide છે, એકલું safe continuous-service temperature નથી.
  • Structure તથા stability: worked vs unworked penetration તફાવત, oil separation તથા water resistance નક્કી કરે છે કે grease bearing માં પોતાનું body જાળવશે કે કેમ.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

ફક્ત penetration grease પસંદ કરતું નથી: bearing grease એ temperature (dropping point), water exposure તથા speed/load સાથે પણ મળવું જોઈએ, નહીં તો સાચી-consistency વાળું grease પણ service માં fail થશે.

h.en: Practical.3/Practical.4 Flash point and fire point by Pensky-Martens (guided)
h.gu: Practical.3/Practical.4 Pensky-Martens થી flash point તથા fire point (guided)

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to determine flash and fire points of a petroleum product sample in a Pensky-Martens closed-cup apparatus under teacher supervision. Apparatus: Pensky-Martens tester, thermometer, test flame, sample cup.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Fill the cup to the mark, close the lid and heat at the rate stated in the laboratory manual for the product.
  2. Apply the test flame through the shutter at the specified temperature intervals and record the temperature of the first distinct flash inside the cup.
  3. Continue heating and record the temperature at which the vapour burns continuously for at least five seconds — the fire point.
  4. Report both temperatures with the product name and barometric correction if the manual requires it.

Precautions

Flammable samples are heated only in the fume-managed laboratory area, away from open flames not part of the apparatus. Expected textbook ranges are not written as results: only temperatures actually observed on the tested sample are recorded in the blank observation table.

Observations and result

Blank record: sample ___, flash point (observed) ___ °C, fire point (observed) ___ °C, remark ___. This practical is presented as a guided method; no measured value is claimed here.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: teacher ની દેખરેખ હેઠળ Pensky-Martens closed-cup apparatus માં petroleum product sample ના flash તથા fire points નક્કી કરવા. Apparatus: Pensky-Martens tester, thermometer, test flame, sample cup.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Cup ને mark સુધી ભરો, lid બંધ કરો અને product માટે laboratory manual માં જણાવેલા rate થી ગરમ કરો.
  2. નિશ્ચિત temperature intervals પર shutter માંથી test flame આપો અને cup ની અંદર પહેલા સ્પષ્ટ flash નું temperature નોંધો.
  3. ગરમ કરવાનું ચાલુ રાખો અને vapour ઓછામાં ઓછી પાંચ seconds સતત બળે તે temperature નોંધો — fire point.
  4. બંને temperatures product name સાથે અને manual જણાવે તો barometric correction સાથે report કરો.

Precautions

Flammable samples ફક્ત fume-managed laboratory area માં, apparatus નો ભાગ ન હોય તેવી open flames થી દૂર, ગરમ કરાય છે. Textbook ના અપેક્ષિત ranges results તરીકે લખાતા નથી: blank observation table માં ફક્ત tested sample પર ખરેખર જોવાયેલા temperatures જ નોંધાય છે.

Observations and result

Blank record: sample ___, flash point (observed) ___ °C, fire point (observed) ___ °C, remark ___. આ practical guided method તરીકે રજૂ થયો છે; અહીં કોઈ measured value નો દાવો નથી.

h.en: Practical.11/Practical.12 Cloud point and pour point (guided)
h.gu: Practical.11/Practical.12 Cloud point તથા pour point (guided)

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to observe cloud and pour points of a diesel/lube sample on controlled cooling. Apparatus: test jars, thermometer, cooling bath, tilting arrangement as per the laboratory manual.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Pour the dry, filtered sample to the mark and cool it in stages, examining it at each stated interval without disturbing it unnecessarily.
  2. Record the temperature at which a distinct cloud/haze first appears at the bottom of the jar — cloud point.
  3. Continue cooling; at each check tilt the jar briefly. The lowest temperature at which the oil still flows, with the manual's correction, gives the pour point.

Precautions

Moisture in the sample gives a false cloud, so filtration/drying and undisturbed cooling matter. Results actually observed are recorded; seasonal specification limits are discussed, not copied as observations.

Observations and result

Blank record: sample ___, cloud point (observed) ___ °C, pour point (observed) ___ °C. Guided method only; no measured value is claimed here.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: controlled cooling પર diesel/lube sample ના cloud તથા pour points અવલોકવા. Apparatus: test jars, thermometer, cooling bath, laboratory manual મુજબ tilting arrangement.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. સૂકું, filtered sample mark સુધી ભરો અને stages માં ઠંડું કરો, દરેક જણાવેલા interval પર બિનજરૂરી હલાવ્યા વગર તપાસો.
  2. Jar ના તળિયે પહેલી સ્પષ્ટ cloud/haze દેખાય તે temperature નોંધો — cloud point.
  3. ઠંડું કરવાનું ચાલુ રાખો; દરેક check પર jar થોડું નમાવો. Oil હજુ વહે તે સૌથી નીચું temperature, manual ના correction સાથે, pour point આપે છે.

Precautions

Sample માં moisture ખોટો cloud આપે છે, તેથી filtration/drying તથા ખલેલ વગરનું cooling મહત્વના છે. ખરેખર જોવાયેલા results નોંધાય છે; seasonal specification limits ની ચર્ચા થાય છે, observations તરીકે copy થતા નથી.

Observations and result

h.en: Practice 1. Explain dehydration and desalting of crude oil with the construction and working of an electrostatic desalter.
h.gu: Practice 1. Electrostatic desalter ના construction તથા working સાથે crude oil નું dehydration તથા desalting સમજાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Desalting washes emulsified salty water out of crude before heating, preventing fouling and HCl corrosion.

Explanation and application

  • Crude + 3–10 % wash water + demulsifier enters the vessel and spreads under electrode grids.
  • The electric field coalesces droplets; large drops settle, desalted oil leaves at the top, brine and mud leave below.

Working salt balance: Numerical 2.N3.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Desalting ગરમ કરતા પહેલાં crude માંથી emulsified ખારું water ધોઈ કાઢે છે, fouling તથા HCl corrosion અટકાવે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Crude + 3–10 % wash water + demulsifier vessel માં પ્રવેશી electrode grids નીચે ફેલાય છે.
  • Electric field droplets ને coalesce કરે છે; મોટા drops બેસી જાય છે, desalted oil ઉપરથી નીકળે છે, brine તથા mud નીચેથી જાય છે.

Worked salt balance: Numerical 2.N3.

h.en: Practice 2. Describe a pipe still heater: construction, working, and two precautions against tube coking.
h.gu: Practice 2. Pipe still heater વર્ણવો: construction, working, અને tube coking સામે બે સાવચેતીઓ.

body.en:
Definition

The pipe still is a tube furnace heating crude to column flash temperature.

Explanation and application

  • Convection tubes recover flue-gas heat; radiant tubes around the firebox give the final temperature.
  • Precautions: control outlet/tube-skin temperature and keep flow in every pass so crude does not crack and coke inside tubes.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pipe still એ tube furnace છે જે crude ને column flash temperature સુધી ગરમ કરે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Convection tubes flue-gas heat recover કરે છે; firebox આસપાસની radiant tubes અંતિમ temperature આપે છે.
  • સાવચેતીઓ: outlet/tube-skin temperature નિયંત્રિત રાખો અને દરેક pass માં flow જાળવો જેથી crude tubes ની અંદર crack તથા coke ન થાય.

h.en: Practice 3. With a neat sketch, explain the working of an atmospheric distillation column and name its products in order.
h.gu: Practice 3. સુઘડ sketch સાથે atmospheric distillation column નું working સમજાવો અને તેના products ક્રમમાં જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition

The ADU fractionates heated crude at about atmospheric pressure by boiling range.

Explanation and application

  • Flash zone, trays with reflux, side strippers for kerosene/diesel, overhead LPG/naphtha, atmospheric residue at the bottom.
  • Temperature falls upward, so products leave in Unit 1.6 order (sketch as in diagram ref2_adu).
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

ADU ગરમ crude ને આશરે atmospheric pressure પર boiling range મુજબ fractionate કરે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Flash zone, reflux સાથે trays, kerosene/diesel માટે side strippers, overhead LPG/naphtha, તળિયે atmospheric residue.
  • Temperature ઉપર તરફ ઘટે છે, તેથી products Unit 1.6 ના ક્રમમાં નીકળે છે (diagram ref2_adu મુજબ sketch).

h.en: Practice 4. Why is vacuum distillation used for crude residue? Explain the VDU products and the role of steam ejectors.
h.gu: Practice 4. Crude residue માટે vacuum distillation કેમ વપરાય છે? VDU products તથા steam ejectors ની ભૂમિકા સમજાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Reduced pressure lowers boiling points, so residue fractions vaporise without cracking.

Explanation and application

  • Steam ejectors + condensers hold a few-kPa vacuum and remove air/cracked gas.
  • Products: vacuum gas oils, lube cuts where operated, and short residue for bitumen/fuel/coking.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

ઘટાડેલું દબાણ boiling points નીચે લાવે છે, તેથી residue fractions cracking વગર vaporise થાય છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Steam ejectors + condensers થોડા-kPa vacuum જાળવી air/cracked gas દૂર કરે છે.
  • Products: vacuum gas oils, જ્યાં ચાલે ત્યાં lube cuts, અને bitumen/fuel/coking માટે short residue.

h.en: Practice 5. State the main physical properties of petrol and diesel and write how each property is measured.
h.gu: Practice 5. Petrol તથા diesel ના મુખ્ય physical properties જણાવો અને દરેક property કેવી રીતે મપાય છે તે લખો.

body.en:
Definition

Fuels are specified by ignition, volatility, cold-flow and safety tests, not composition alone.

Key points and data

  • Petrol: RON/MON (CFR engine), RVP at 37.8 °C, distillation, density.
  • Diesel: cetane, flash point (closed cup), cloud/pour points, viscosity.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fuels ફક્ત composition થી નહીં, ignition, volatility, cold-flow તથા safety tests થી specified થાય છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Petrol: RON/MON (CFR engine), 37.8 °C પર RVP, distillation, density.
  • Diesel: cetane, flash point (closed cup), cloud/pour points, viscosity.

h.en: Practice 6. Define smoke point, cloud point, pour point and penetration, stating the product and practical test associated with each.
h.gu: Practice 6. Smoke point, cloud point, pour point તથા penetration વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો, દરેક સાથે સંકળાયેલ product તથા practical test જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Each term is a standard-test property of a named product.

Key points and data

  • Smoke point (kerosene lamp test, mm), cloud then pour point on cooling (diesel/lube jars).
  • Penetration: cone depth in grease (tenths of mm, NLGI grade), Practical 7 pattern.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

દરેક શબ્દ નામ આપેલા product નો standard-test property છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Smoke point (kerosene lamp test, mm), ઠંડું પડતાં પહેલાં cloud પછી pour point (diesel/lube jars).
  • Penetration: grease માં cone depth (millimetre ના દસમા ભાગમાં, NLGI grade), Practical 7 pattern.

h.en: Practice 7. A heater raises 5000 kg/h of crude (cp 2.10 kJ/kg·°C) from 25 °C to 350 °C. Calculate the duty in kW, showing every step.
h.gu: Practice 7. Heater 5000 kg/h crude (cp 2.10 kJ/kg·°C) ને 25 °C થી 350 °C ઊંચું કરે છે. દરેક step બતાવી duty kW માં ગણો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

m = 5000 kg/h, cp = 2.10 kJ/kg·°C constant, ΔT = 325 °C, sensible heating only.

Step-by-step solution

Q = 5000 × 2.10 × 325 = 3 412 500 kJ/h; ÷ 3600 = 947.9 kW.

Interpretation and check

Duty = 948 kW. Full locked-style working with fuel firing is in Numerical 2.N1.
body.gu:
આપેલ તથા ધારણાઓ

m = 5000 kg/h, cp = 2.10 kJ/kg·°C constant, ΔT = 325 °C, ફક્ત sensible heating.

Step-by-step solution

Q = 5000 × 2.10 × 325 = 3 412 500 kJ/h; ÷ 3600 = 947.9 kW.

અર્થઘટન તથા check

Duty = 948 kW. Fuel firing સાથે સંપૂર્ણ locked-style working Numerical 2.N1 માં છે.

h.en: Practice 8. Explain viscosity and viscosity index for a lubricant oil, and penetration and dropping point for a grease.
h.gu: Practice 8. Lubricant oil માટે viscosity તથા viscosity index, અને grease માટે penetration તથા dropping point સમજાવો.

body.en:
Definition

VI expresses how little a lube's viscosity changes with temperature; grease tests express consistency and thickener heat resistance.

Explanation and application

  • High VI = wider usable temperature range; viscosity is measured at 40/100 °C.
  • Penetration in tenths of mm sets NLGI grade (higher = softer); dropping point is the first-drop temperature on heating.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

VI દર્શાવે છે કે lube ની viscosity temperature સાથે કેટલી ઓછી બદલાય છે; grease tests consistency તથા thickener heat resistance દર્શાવે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • High VI = વધુ વિશાળ ઉપયોગી temperature range; viscosity 40/100 °C પર મપાય છે.
  • Millimetre ના દસમા ભાગમાં penetration NLGI grade નક્કી કરે છે (વધુ = નરમ); dropping point ગરમ કરતાં first-drop temperature છે.

q.en: Numerical 2.N1: A pipe still heater heats 5000 kg/h of desalted crude (cp = 2.10 kJ/kg·°C) from 25 °C to 350 °C. Heater efficiency is 75 % and fuel oil calorific value is 40 000 kJ/kg. Calculate the heater duty and fuel consumption.
q.gu: Numerical 2.N1: Pipe still heater 5000 kg/h desalted crude (cp = 2.10 kJ/kg·°C) ને 25 °C થી 350 °C ગરમ કરે છે. Heater efficiency 75 % છે અને fuel oil calorific value 40 000 kJ/kg છે. Heater duty તથા fuel consumption ગણો.

a.en:
Given

Mass flow m = 5000 kg/h; specific heat cp = 2.10 kJ/kg·°C (taken constant); inlet 25 °C, outlet 350 °C; heater efficiency η = 0.75; fuel calorific value CV = 40 000 kJ/kg. Sensible heating only, no vaporisation in the heater is assumed for this sizing calculation.

Find

Find the useful heater duty and the fuel oil fired per hour.

Formula

Q = m × cp × (T2 − T1)
Fuel fired = Q / (η × CV)

Substitution and calculation

ΔT = 350 − 25 = 325 °C
Q = 5000 × 2.10 × 325 = 3 412 500 kJ/h
Q = 3 412 500 / 3600 = 947.9 kW (useful duty)
Fuel = 3 412 500 / (0.75 × 40 000) = 113.75 kg/h

Final answer with units

Useful duty Q = 3.41 × 10^6 kJ/h = 948 kW
Fuel oil fired = 114 kg/h

Validity check

Fuel energy in = 114 × 40 000 ≈ 4.55 × 10^6 kJ/h, and 75 % of it is 3.41 × 10^6 kJ/h, matching the duty. In a real heater cp rises with temperature and part of the crude may vaporise, so this constant-cp value is a sizing estimate, to be refined with enthalpy tables.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Mass flow m = 5000 kg/h; specific heat cp = 2.10 kJ/kg·°C (constant લીધી); inlet 25 °C, outlet 350 °C; heater efficiency η = 0.75; fuel calorific value CV = 40 000 kJ/kg. આ sizing ગણતરી માટે ફક્ત sensible heating ધાર્યું છે, heater માં vaporisation નહીં.

શોધો

Useful heater duty તથા કલાક દીઠ બળતું fuel oil શોધો.

સૂત્ર

Q = m × cp × (T2 − T1)
Fuel fired = Q / (η × CV)

Substitution તથા Calculation

ΔT = 350 − 25 = 325 °C
Q = 5000 × 2.10 × 325 = 3 412 500 kJ/h
Q = 3 412 500 / 3600 = 947.9 kW (useful duty)
Fuel = 3 412 500 / (0.75 × 40 000) = 113.75 kg/h

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Useful duty Q = 3.41 × 10^6 kJ/h = 948 kW
Fuel oil fired = 114 kg/h

Validity Check

Fuel energy in = 114 × 40 000 ≈ 4.55 × 10^6 kJ/h, અને તેના 75 % એટલે 3.41 × 10^6 kJ/h, duty સાથે મળે છે. વાસ્તવિક heater માં cp temperature સાથે વધે છે અને crude નો ભાગ vaporise થઈ શકે છે, તેથી આ constant-cp મૂલ્ય sizing estimate છે, enthalpy tables થી refine કરવાનું રહે છે.

q.en: Numerical 2.N2: A column is fed 1000 kg/h of crude fraction (light-component mass fraction xF = 0.40). The distillate is to have xD = 0.90 and the bottoms xB = 0.05 in the same component. Using the derivation of card 2.2, calculate D and B.
q.gu: Numerical 2.N2: Column ને 1000 kg/h crude fraction મળે છે (light-component mass fraction xF = 0.40). Distillate માં xD = 0.90 અને bottoms માં xB = 0.05 જોઈએ છે. Card 2.2 ના derivation નો ઉપયોગ કરી D તથા B ગણો.

a.en:
Given

Feed F = 1000 kg/h; xF = 0.40, xD = 0.90, xB = 0.05 (mass fractions of the same light component). Steady state, no reaction.

Find

Find the distillate rate D and bottoms rate B.

Formula

D = F × (xF − xB) / (xD − xB)
B = F − D

Substitution and calculation

D = 1000 × (0.40 − 0.05) / (0.90 − 0.05)
D = 1000 × 0.35 / 0.85 = 411.76 kg/h
B = 1000 − 411.76 = 588.24 kg/h
Light check: 411.76 × 0.90 + 588.24 × 0.05 = 370.59 + 29.41 = 400.00 kg/h

Final answer with units

D = 412 kg/h, B = 588 kg/h

Validity check

Light component out = 400.00 kg/h = 1000 × 0.40 in the feed, so both balances close. Note that D must lie between the two limits: if xB rose toward xF, D would fall toward zero — the formula itself warns when a specified split is impossible.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Feed F = 1000 kg/h; xF = 0.40, xD = 0.90, xB = 0.05 (એ જ light component ના mass fractions). Steady state, reaction નહીં.

શોધો

Distillate rate D તથા bottoms rate B શોધો.

સૂત્ર

D = F × (xF − xB) / (xD − xB)
B = F − D

Substitution તથા Calculation

D = 1000 × (0.40 − 0.05) / (0.90 − 0.05)
D = 1000 × 0.35 / 0.85 = 411.76 kg/h
B = 1000 − 411.76 = 588.24 kg/h
Light check: 411.76 × 0.90 + 588.24 × 0.05 = 370.59 + 29.41 = 400.00 kg/h

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

D = 412 kg/h, B = 588 kg/h

Validity Check

Light component out = 400.00 kg/h = feed માં 1000 × 0.40, તેથી બંને balances close થાય છે. નોંધો કે D બે limits વચ્ચે જ હોવું જોઈએ: જો xB xF તરફ વધે તો D zero તરફ ઘટશે — formula પોતે જ ચેતવે છે જ્યારે specified split અશક્ય હોય.

q.en: Numerical 2.N3: A desalter treats 20 000 kg/h of crude containing 80 mg of salt per kg of crude. Desalting removes 90 % of the salt. Calculate the salt leaving per hour, the salt remaining in the desalted crude, and the outlet salt content in mg/kg.
q.gu: Numerical 2.N3: Desalter 20 000 kg/h crude ને treat કરે છે જેમાં crude ના kg દીઠ 80 mg salt છે. Desalting 90 % salt દૂર કરે છે. કલાક દીઠ નીકળતું salt, desalted crude માં રહેતું salt, અને mg/kg માં outlet salt content ગણો.

a.en:
Given

Crude rate = 20 000 kg/h; inlet salt content = 80 mg/kg of crude; salt removal = 90 % of the salt entering. Salt is carried out with the removed brine.

Find

Find (a) salt in with the crude, (b) salt removed, (c) salt left in crude and its content in mg/kg.

Formula

Salt in = crude rate × inlet salt content
Salt left = salt in × (1 − removal fraction)

Substitution and calculation

Salt in = 20 000 × 80 = 1 600 000 mg/h = 1.60 kg/h
Salt removed = 1.60 × 0.90 = 1.44 kg/h
Salt left = 1.60 − 1.44 = 0.16 kg/h
Outlet content = 0.16 kg/h / 20 000 kg/h = 8 mg/kg

Final answer with units

Salt removed = 1.44 kg/h; salt left = 0.16 kg/h = 8 mg/kg

Validity check

8 mg/kg is exactly 10 % of the inlet 80 mg/kg, matching the stated 90 % removal, and 1.44 + 0.16 = 1.60 kg/h closes the salt balance. Illustrative data, not measured plant readings.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Crude rate = 20 000 kg/h; inlet salt content = crude ના kg દીઠ 80 mg; salt removal = પ્રવેશતા salt ના 90 %. Salt removed brine સાથે બહાર જાય છે.

શોધો

(a) crude સાથે આવતું salt, (b) દૂર થતું salt, (c) crude માં રહેતું salt તથા તેનું content mg/kg માં શોધો.

સૂત્ર

Salt in = crude rate × inlet salt content
Salt left = salt in × (1 − removal fraction)

Substitution તથા Calculation

Salt in = 20 000 × 80 = 1 600 000 mg/h = 1.60 kg/h
Salt removed = 1.60 × 0.90 = 1.44 kg/h
Salt left = 1.60 − 1.44 = 0.16 kg/h
Outlet content = 0.16 kg/h / 20 000 kg/h = 8 mg/kg

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Salt removed = 1.44 kg/h; salt left = 0.16 kg/h = 8 mg/kg

Validity Check

8 mg/kg બરાબર inlet 80 mg/kg ના 10 % છે, જણાવેલા 90 % removal સાથે મળે છે, અને 1.44 + 0.16 = 1.60 kg/h salt balance close કરે છે. Illustrative data છે, measured plant readings નથી.

q.en: Numerical 2.N4: A petrol blend mixes 600 litres of 92 RON component with 400 litres of 98 RON component. Estimate the blend RON on a volume-linear basis and state the limitation of the estimate.
q.gu: Numerical 2.N4: Petrol blend 600 litres 92 RON component ને 400 litres 98 RON component સાથે ભેળવે છે. Volume-linear basis પર blend RON નો અંદાજ કરો અને અંદાજની મર્યાદા જણાવો.

a.en:
Given

Component 1: 600 L at 92 RON. Component 2: 400 L at 98 RON. Total 1000 L. Volume-linear (ideal) blending is assumed for this estimate only.

Find

Estimate the blend RON.

Formula

Blend RON = (V1 × RON1 + V2 × RON2) / (V1 + V2)

Substitution and calculation

Blend RON = (600 × 92 + 400 × 98) / 1000
Blend RON = (55 200 + 39 200) / 1000 = 94.40

Final answer with units

Estimated blend RON = 94.4 (dimensionless)

Validity check

94.4 lies between 92 and 98, closer to 92 because the 92-RON component is the larger share — the expected behaviour of an average. Real octane blending is non-linear and oxygenates shift the result, so the finished blend must be engine-tested; this number is a planning estimate, not a specification certificate.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Component 1: 600 L, 92 RON. Component 2: 400 L, 98 RON. કુલ 1000 L. આ અંદાજ માટે જ volume-linear (ideal) blending ધાર્યું છે.

શોધો

Blend RON નો અંદાજ કરો.

સૂત્ર

Blend RON = (V1 × RON1 + V2 × RON2) / (V1 + V2)

Substitution તથા Calculation

Blend RON = (600 × 92 + 400 × 98) / 1000
Blend RON = (55 200 + 39 200) / 1000 = 94.40

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Estimated blend RON = 94.4 (dimensionless)

Validity Check

94.4 એ 92 તથા 98 વચ્ચે છે, 92 ની નજીક કારણ કે 92-RON component નો હિસ્સો મોટો છે — average નું અપેક્ષિત વર્તન. વાસ્તવિક octane blending non-linear છે અને oxygenates result બદલે છે, તેથી finished blend engine-test થવો જ જોઈએ; આ આંકડો planning estimate છે, specification certificate નથી.

title.en: Unit 2 viva — fractionation and product properties
title.gu: Unit 2 viva — fractionation તથા product properties

q.en: Why is crude desalted before preheating?
q.gu: Crude preheat પહેલાં કેમ desalt થાય છે?

a.en: To stop salt fouling preheat exchangers and forming hydrochloric acid at high temperature, which corrodes the crude-unit overhead system.
a.gu: Salt preheat exchangers foul ન કરે અને ઊંચા temperature પર hydrochloric acid ન બનાવે, જે crude-unit overhead system ને corrode કરે છે.

q.en: How does an electrostatic desalter separate water from oil?
q.gu: Electrostatic desalter oil માંથી water કેવી રીતે છૂટું પાડે છે?

a.en: The electric field polarises emulsified water droplets so they coalesce into large drops that settle by gravity below the oil.
a.gu: Electric field emulsified water droplets ને polarise કરે છે જેથી તેઓ coalesce થઈ મોટા drops બને અને gravity થી oil નીચે બેસી જાય.

q.en: What are the two sections of a pipe still heater?
q.gu: Pipe still heater ના બે sections કયા છે?

a.en: The radiant section around the firebox, where tubes receive flame radiation, and the convection section above, which recovers heat from flue gas.
a.gu: Firebox આસપાસનો radiant section, જ્યાં tubes flame radiation મેળવે છે, અને ઉપરનો convection section, જે flue gas માંથી heat recover કરે છે.

q.en: Why does crude flash in the column and not in the heater tubes?
q.gu: Crude column માં કેમ flash થાય છે, heater tubes માં કેમ નહીં?

a.en: In the tubes it is held liquid under pressure; on entering the column the pressure drops, so the fractions within their boiling range vaporise in the flash zone.
a.gu: Tubes માં તે દબાણ હેઠળ liquid રખાય છે; column માં પ્રવેશતાં દબાણ ઘટે છે, તેથી boiling range માંના fractions flash zone માં vaporise થાય છે.

q.en: What is the purpose of reflux in the ADU?
q.gu: ADU માં reflux નો હેતુ શું છે?

a.en: Reflux provides descending liquid that contacts rising vapour on the trays, condensing heavy ends and sharpening the separation and top-temperature control.
a.gu: Reflux ઊતરતું liquid આપે છે જે trays પર ચઢતી vapour ના સંપર્કમાં આવે છે, heavy ends condense કરે છે અને separation તથા top-temperature control sharp કરે છે.

q.en: Why is atmospheric residue distilled under vacuum?
q.gu: Atmospheric residue vacuum હેઠળ કેમ distill થાય છે?

a.en: Lower pressure lowers boiling points, so heavy gas oil and lube fractions vaporise at temperatures low enough to avoid thermal cracking.
a.gu: ઓછું દબાણ boiling points ઘટાડે છે, તેથી heavy gas oil તથા lube fractions thermal cracking ટાળવા જેટલા નીચા temperatures પર vaporise થાય છે.

q.en: Name the VDU products.
q.gu: VDU products જણાવો.

a.en: Light and heavy vacuum gas oil, lube distillate cuts where operated, and vacuum (short) residue for bitumen, fuel oil or coking.
a.gu: Light તથા heavy vacuum gas oil, જ્યાં ચાલે ત્યાં lube distillate cuts, અને bitumen, fuel oil કે coking માટે vacuum (short) residue.

q.en: What does octane number measure and against what references?
q.gu: Octane number શું માપે છે અને કયા references સામે?

a.en: Knock resistance of petrol in a standard engine, against iso-octane rated 100 and n-heptane rated 0.
a.gu: Standard engine માં petrol નો knock resistance, iso-octane ને 100 તથા n-heptane ને 0 rated references સામે.

q.en: Distinguish cloud point and pour point.
q.gu: Cloud point તથા pour point વચ્ચે તફાવત કરો.

a.en: Cloud point is where wax first makes the oil hazy on cooling; pour point is the temperature below which the oil no longer flows on tilting, and it is never above the cloud point.
a.gu: Cloud point એ છે જ્યાં ઠંડું પડતાં wax પહેલાં oil ને hazy કરે છે; pour point એ temperature છે જેનાથી નીચે નમાવતાં oil વહેતું નથી, અને તે કદી cloud point થી ઉપર નથી.

q.en: What is smoke point and why do aromatics lower it?
q.gu: Smoke point શું છે અને aromatics તેને કેમ ઘટાડે છે?

a.en: Smoke point is the maximum smokeless flame height in mm in a standard lamp. Aromatics burn with a sooty flame, so the flame must be kept lower before smoking starts.
a.gu: Smoke point એ standard lamp માં ધુમાડા વગરની મહત્તમ flame height mm માં છે. Aromatics sooty flame થી બળે છે, તેથી smoking શરૂ થાય તે પહેલાં flame નીચી રાખવી પડે છે.

q.en: What does viscosity index tell about a lubricant?
q.gu: Viscosity index lubricant વિશે શું કહે છે?

a.en: How little its viscosity changes between cold and hot: a high-VI oil stays usable over a wider temperature range.
a.gu: ઠંડા તથા ગરમ વચ્ચે તેની viscosity કેટલી ઓછી બદલાય છે: high-VI oil વધુ વિશાળ temperature range માં ઉપયોગી રહે છે.

q.en: What do penetration and dropping point mean for a grease?
q.gu: Grease માટે penetration તથા dropping point નો અર્થ શું છે?

a.en: Penetration measures consistency (higher = softer, NLGI grade); dropping point is the temperature at which the first drop falls on heating and guides the thickener's temperature limit.
a.gu: Penetration consistency માપે છે (વધુ = નરમ, NLGI grade); dropping point એ temperature છે જ્યાં ગરમ કરતાં પહેલો drop પડે છે અને thickener ની temperature limit નું માર્ગદર્શન આપે છે.

q.en: Practice: Explain dehydration and desalting of crude oil with the construction and working of an electrostatic desalter.
q.gu: Practice: Electrostatic desalter ના construction તથા working સાથે crude oil નું dehydration તથા desalting સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Describe a pipe still heater: construction, working, and two precautions against tube coking.
q.gu: Practice: Pipe still heater વર્ણવો: construction, working, અને tube coking સામે બે સાવચેતીઓ.

q.en: Practice: With a neat sketch, explain the working of an atmospheric distillation column and name its products in order.
q.gu: Practice: સુઘડ sketch સાથે atmospheric distillation column નું working સમજાવો અને તેના products ક્રમમાં જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Why is vacuum distillation used for crude residue? Explain the VDU products and the role of steam ejectors.
q.gu: Practice: Crude residue માટે vacuum distillation કેમ વપરાય છે? VDU products તથા steam ejectors ની ભૂમિકા સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: State the main physical properties of petrol and diesel and write how each property is measured.
q.gu: Practice: Petrol તથા diesel ના મુખ્ય physical properties જણાવો અને દરેક property કેવી રીતે મપાય છે તે લખો.

q.en: Practice: Define smoke point, cloud point, pour point and penetration, stating the product and practical test associated with each.
q.gu: Practice: Smoke point, cloud point, pour point તથા penetration વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો, દરેક સાથે સંકળાયેલ product તથા practical test જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: A heater raises 5000 kg/h of crude (cp 2.10 kJ/kg·°C) from 25 °C to 350 °C. Calculate the duty in kW, showing every step.
q.gu: Practice: Heater 5000 kg/h crude (cp 2.10 kJ/kg·°C) ને 25 °C થી 350 °C ઊંચું કરે છે. દરેક step બતાવી duty kW માં ગણો.

q.en: Practice: Explain viscosity and viscosity index for a lubricant oil, and penetration and dropping point for a grease.
q.gu: Practice: Lubricant oil માટે viscosity તથા viscosity index, અને grease માટે penetration તથા dropping point સમજાવો.

title.en: Determine flash point of petroleum product by Pensky-Martens method
title.gu: Pensky-Martens method થી petroleum product નો flash point નક્કી કરો

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to determine flash and fire points of a petroleum product sample in a Pensky-Martens closed-cup apparatus under teacher supervision. Apparatus: Pensky-Martens tester, thermometer, test flame, sample cup.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Fill the cup to the mark, close the lid and heat at the rate stated in the laboratory manual for the product.
  2. Apply the test flame through the shutter at the specified temperature intervals and record the temperature of the first distinct flash inside the cup.
  3. Continue heating and record the temperature at which the vapour burns continuously for at least five seconds — the fire point.
  4. Report both temperatures with the product name and barometric correction if the manual requires it.

Precautions

Flammable samples are heated only in the fume-managed laboratory area, away from open flames not part of the apparatus. Expected textbook ranges are not written as results: only temperatures actually observed on the tested sample are recorded in the blank observation table.

Observations and result

Blank record: sample ___, flash point (observed) ___ °C, fire point (observed) ___ °C, remark ___. This practical is presented as a guided method; no measured value is claimed here.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: teacher ની દેખરેખ હેઠળ Pensky-Martens closed-cup apparatus માં petroleum product sample ના flash તથા fire points નક્કી કરવા. Apparatus: Pensky-Martens tester, thermometer, test flame, sample cup.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Cup ને mark સુધી ભરો, lid બંધ કરો અને product માટે laboratory manual માં જણાવેલા rate થી ગરમ કરો.
  2. નિશ્ચિત temperature intervals પર shutter માંથી test flame આપો અને cup ની અંદર પહેલા સ્પષ્ટ flash નું temperature નોંધો.
  3. ગરમ કરવાનું ચાલુ રાખો અને vapour ઓછામાં ઓછી પાંચ seconds સતત બળે તે temperature નોંધો — fire point.
  4. બંને temperatures product name સાથે અને manual જણાવે તો barometric correction સાથે report કરો.

Precautions

Flammable samples ફક્ત fume-managed laboratory area માં, apparatus નો ભાગ ન હોય તેવી open flames થી દૂર, ગરમ કરાય છે. Textbook ના અપેક્ષિત ranges results તરીકે લખાતા નથી: blank observation table માં ફક્ત tested sample પર ખરેખર જોવાયેલા temperatures જ નોંધાય છે.

Observations and result

Blank record: sample ___, flash point (observed) ___ °C, fire point (observed) ___ °C, remark ___. આ practical guided method તરીકે રજૂ થયો છે; અહીં કોઈ measured value નો દાવો નથી.

title.en: Measure cloud point of given petroleum product
title.gu: આપેલા petroleum product નો cloud point માપો

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to observe cloud and pour points of a diesel/lube sample on controlled cooling. Apparatus: test jars, thermometer, cooling bath, tilting arrangement as per the laboratory manual.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Pour the dry, filtered sample to the mark and cool it in stages, examining it at each stated interval without disturbing it unnecessarily.
  2. Record the temperature at which a distinct cloud/haze first appears at the bottom of the jar — cloud point.
  3. Continue cooling; at each check tilt the jar briefly. The lowest temperature at which the oil still flows, with the manual's correction, gives the pour point.

Precautions

Moisture in the sample gives a false cloud, so filtration/drying and undisturbed cooling matter. Results actually observed are recorded; seasonal specification limits are discussed, not copied as observations.

Observations and result

Blank record: sample ___, cloud point (observed) ___ °C, pour point (observed) ___ °C. Guided method only; no measured value is claimed here.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: controlled cooling પર diesel/lube sample ના cloud તથા pour points અવલોકવા. Apparatus: test jars, thermometer, cooling bath, laboratory manual મુજબ tilting arrangement.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. સૂકું, filtered sample mark સુધી ભરો અને stages માં ઠંડું કરો, દરેક જણાવેલા interval પર બિનજરૂરી હલાવ્યા વગર તપાસો.
  2. Jar ના તળિયે પહેલી સ્પષ્ટ cloud/haze દેખાય તે temperature નોંધો — cloud point.
  3. ઠંડું કરવાનું ચાલુ રાખો; દરેક check પર jar થોડું નમાવો. Oil હજુ વહે તે સૌથી નીચું temperature, manual ના correction સાથે, pour point આપે છે.

Precautions

Sample માં moisture ખોટો cloud આપે છે, તેથી filtration/drying તથા ખલેલ વગરનું cooling મહત્વના છે. ખરેખર જોવાયેલા results નોંધાય છે; seasonal specification limits ની ચર્ચા થાય છે, observations તરીકે copy થતા નથી.

Observations and result

Blank record: sample ___, cloud point (observed) ___ °C, pour point (observed) ___ °C. ફક્ત guided method; અહીં કોઈ measured value નો દાવો નથી.
